name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafCover_zmod
title: Coverage of the leaf box sampler over Z_q by a simulation trapdoor
statement: Over Z_q, with gadget decompositions and dec of entries at most 1, bit inputs x and input trapdoors Wm with entries at most E: for every v in ball s and every y, v + evalSim(phi, A, x, Wm) dec(-y) lies in the big box of Bb bits, provided s + k * errBound k E phi <= 2^(Bb-1) - 1, 2^Bb <= q and Bb >= 1.
